changelog:
**Summary:** Adds new robotics & embodied AI developments and expands autonomous driving simulation coverage.

- Updated Autonomous Driving Simulation section with ConFixGS (confidence-aware diffusion repair) and its applicability.
- Significantly expanded Robotics & Embodied AI: added new sub-directions, tools, and key papers (GaussianGrasper, GraspSplats, ManiGaussian, RoboSplat, GSMem, VR-Robo, Forecast-GS) and clarified 3DGS vs. NeRF for manipulation.
- Added "World Model Integration" section outlining 3DGS as a core primitive for world models, example methods per domain, and engineering implications.
- Clarified maturity/role for Robotics & Embodied AI to "Rapidly Growing" with improved structuring.
- No changes to the base engineering stack or other verticals.
